refrain: Glory be to You, our God, glory be to You!
comment:
Canon in Tone 6.
It is modeled on the Holy Thursday canon and has the acrostic: "I sing a long song of the Great Thursday".
(For this canon, choosing to 'Shorten the canon' above will remove only the repetitions. All the constituent parts will remain.)

odes.hirmos: The Red Sea was parted by a blow from the staff of Moses,* and the deep with its waves became dry,* becoming a path to the unarmed people of Israel,* but to the fully armed ones it became a grave.* A hymn of praise well-pleasing to God was sung:* gloriously has Christ our God been glorified.
troparia: The Cause of all and the Bestower of life, the infinite Wisdom of God has built His house from a pure Mother who has not known a man. For clothing Himself in a bodily temple, Christ our God has gloriously been glorified.

Instructing them in the Mysteries, the true Wisdom of God calls the magi as first among gentiles. To mystically nourish those who were speach-less prior, a mystical Supper is lying in a manger. It is now approached under the guidance of a star by those with gifts.

Let us give ear to the Spirit-filled prophetic voices that are now being accomplished. The Virgin is bearing in her womb, and comes to give birth to the One Who is above nature. He was shown to the magi by the sky, and to the shepherds by the angels - as a newborn carried around.

odes.hirmos: O Lord You are the God and Creator of all,* becoming poor, You have united Yourself without passion to a creature,* and as a newborn carried in flesh You accept veneration from inside a poor manger;* crying aloud: Eat My Body, and you shall be firmly established in the faith.
troparia: Herod rages, seeking to slay Christ before His time—He who came to offer His Blood for the redemption of the world—the madman, even before the madness of Pilate! And in his murderous cruelty he slew a multitude of newborns.

A foolish man says: ”There is no God!” He is filled with ultimate insanity, he is sick with Christ-killing, in his audacity falling off from reason, he fully armed himself for slaughtering newborn innocents and polluted the ground with blood.

odes.hirmos: Foreseeing Your ineffable mystery, O Christ, the Prophet cried aloud:* “You have manifested the power of Your love, O merciful Father,* for in Your goodness You have sent Your only-begotten Son* to cleanse the world from sin.
troparia: O Lord, having descended into the one who bore You as rain upon wool and as a drop onto the ground, You are coming in mercy to be born and to live among men, for the Father has sent You, His only-begotten Son, to cleanse the world.

Partaking mortal human flesh, O Christ, from Abraham's seed, You come to bestow grace for grace and to save Your image removing corruption: for the Father has sent You, His only-begotten Son, to cleanse the world.
A new Drink that David longed for of old, comes to gush forth to Bethlehem, and to quench thirst of the soul, of Adam and of David, from whom now Christ is about to be born.

odes.hirmos: Bound with the bond of fraternal love, let us offer glory the Master of all, Who loved the world so much, and gave His beloved Son as Redemption - Him who gives peace to all.
troparia: The Wisdom of God that holds back the untamed fury of the waters above the firmament, and which bridles the deep, holding back the seas, now inhabits the womb of the Virgin, descending like dew upon wool.

Christ calls the Magi to understanding, the disciples of Balaam the magician. He who has wrapped the heaven in clouds, is wrapped in swaddling clothes; and He before Whom tremble the cherubim lies in a manger, and the One who fills all things is contained in a shed.

odes.hirmos: The uttermost depths of sin have encompassed me;* and its stormy waves I can endure no more,* wherefore like Jonah, I cry out to You, O Master:* Lead me up from corruption.
troparia: Knowing You as the Lord, the heavens proclaim Your glory, O Saviour, and today, by a star, they call the magi to the knowledge of You and to the worship of the Divine.
He who has once been washed from defilement, should cast it away, and as one purified, he may touch Christ, the Pure One, who lies in a manger as a newborn and cleanses the depth of hearts.

odes.hirmos: In Babylon the children feared not the fiery furnace;* but cast into the midst of the flames* they were bedewed and sang:* “O God of our fathers, blessed are You.”
troparia: With bowed head, Herod plotted evil, seeking an opportunity to slay the God of life and death, who is Lord of all and the God of our fathers.
Those of you who are friends of Christ, flee with Him who flees to Egypt, and, rightly worshipping Him, call upon Him in a manner pleasing to God, and glorify Him in unity.
“He who is not with Me is against Me”, says Christ, ”and who does not gather with Me, is like the one who scatters.” Therefore, let us stand in awe of His descent in the flesh!

odes.hirmos: Suffering affliction for the sake of the laws of their fathers,* the blessed children in Babylon scorned the foolish decree of the King.* Standing together in the midst of the flames, they remained unharmed,* and sang a song fitting for almighty God:* “O you works of the Lord, praise the Lord* and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.”
troparia: O children, wise in God, who come to Bethlehem to the Word, let us contemplate the miracle together with the angels and the shepherds, glorifying God in the highest, who grants on earth peace and good will among men: “O you works of the Lord, praise the Lord and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.”

Holding fast to the law of love, let us take up the will to love our brethren, to be at peace with each other, and to be of one mind. For the giver of peace, Christ, is coming, granting peace to all and saving those who cry out: “O you works of the Lord, praise the Lord and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.”

With deceitful words the iniquitous Herod honours Christ who is to be born, bows to the magi, and promises to worship Him. He was not ashamed to persecute the hiding Christ, nor did he spare the newborns, nor did he know to cry: “O you works of the Lord, praise the Lord and supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.”

odes.hirmos: Come, O faithful, let us raise our minds on high* and enjoy the Master’s journeys* and the table of immortality in the poor shed;* and let us behold the Word ineffably take flesh, whom we magnify.
troparia: “Go,” said Herod to the chief Magi, “seek the Child. When you find Him, report to me swiftly!” For he was plotting deceit in his heart. But the deceiver was exposed, for he was iniquitous in vain.

Before all ages the Father has begotten the Creator, who is Wisdom and the Word and the Power of God, and He is to be born of the Virgin. Knowing Him as the Only-begotten Son, God and Man, the Lord, we extol Him.

You appeared as a man in truth, not in illusion, O Saviour: as God in Your bearing and in retribution, and still in the nature which You took upon Yourself. Therefore we extol and honour Your divine coming from the Virgin.
